environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed as a Kubernetes pod in namespace 'data-pipeline' on a cluster running k8s 1.24. Pod runs as root (UID 0) with hostPath volume mount at /var/data mapped to host filesystem. No PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforcement. Container has SYS_ADMIN capability. UPLOAD_DIR=/var/data/uploads, OUTPUT_DIR=/var/data/assembled pointing to hostPath mount.
